integrity: Finite exhaustive tests provide consistency checks only; the universal statement is supported by an explicit proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only two-by-two matrices. The zero product fiber and commuting-pair enumeration are known; the new claim is the nonzero nilpotent-product fiber profile, total, and conditional probability. Equivalent implications of older centralizer/representation theory remain an originality risk.
title: Nilpotent-product fibers of commuting two-by-two matrices over finite fields
